semantic_fidelity.reason: All nine historical network concepts and eight qualified relations are visible across v1/v2/v3, with full-address anchors, /29 facts, both R7725 identities, the one active NIC, seven dark ports, and the ordered upstream chain. Repeated NIC and gateway anchors provide cross-view continuity. no cable?, ToR?, free?, L2?, the bridge/tunnel/silent note and 8.3-8.6 ms preserve qualifications; solid styling does not cancel explicit tentative text. Standalone notes carry facts, not invented hops. Contextual site/diagnostic prose is not an additional required graph relationship.

arrow_traceability.reason: Every required arrow has a complete source stem and unique correctly directed head. Eight of eight routes are traceable. No crossing, bus merger or false branch is drawn. v2 has three crowded adjacent-cell contacts, but the distinct bend strokes and heads at (46,17), (46,19), (46,21) resolve them. All eight routes are near-minimal in the check and visibly monotone offsets; no avoidable loop was found. The source requests no shared bus; plain edges preserve inbound direction.

layout_fit.reason: All three actual ANSI frames are 77 columns by 47 rows, with the running app header token 77x47 @100%. All complete boxes, labels and heads remain visible, outside the control palette. Check viewport unknown is not used as size proof. v1/v2/v3 extents are 48x21, 69x18, 68x29; no panning or zoom-out is needed. Zero bridge crossings, no dropped relation or reordered source-required tier.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Normal ANSI shows the inactive and active physical NIC plant in related golden hues; the adjacent Airtel access/backbone nodes use related cyan hues. Host, address-pool, gateway and explanatory-fact roles use distinct semantic groups rather than depth cycling; the two v3 explanatory notes share a green family and occupy the side-note region. Source chain order is intact. Per-node hue stability across views is not a separate gate.

border_integrity.reason: ANSI cell inspection proves all four sides/corners complete and per-node color-continuous in 15/15 normal and 15/15 selected node occurrences. Selected borders are bold RGB 216,166,87; arrows do not erase perimeter cells. Select-all captures prove every perimeter, not separate single-node interactions, dragging or resizing.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen skill, executable, rubric, dataset, source and final-spec hashes verify; separate declared DeepSeek/Sol identities, immutable blind-first record, actual target-size captures and confirmed pane closes are present. Empty trunks is justified explicitly in generation.json and is not an omission. Required workflow evidence remains incomplete: all three frame dumps are absent (a static-case workflow gap, not a rendering defect), original v0 probe outputs were overwritten and replaced by disclosed reruns, and exact per-attempt commands/exit statuses/separate stderr/timestamps are not preserved. Therefore validator green does not establish a complete reproducible execution audit. Missing evidence is blocked, not silently passed.

animation.reason: The source task requests an observed layout, not moving dots; expected.json and cases.json explicitly mark animation optional. Generator selected static dots:0 on all eight routes. No animated route or dot is visible. Motion is source-backed N/A, not a temporal pass inferred from absent frames; missing frame artifacts remain recorded separately under workflow_evidence.
